name: Ridley Corporation Limited
summary: Ridley Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing and distribution animal nutrition solutions in Australia the United States, New Zealand, India, Indonesia, and Thailand. It operates through Packaged Feeds and Ingredients, Fertilisers, and Bulk Stockfeeds segments. The company provides aqua feeds, bulk ruminant stockfeeds, bulk monogastric stockfeeds, animal proteins and oils, and commodities; and NovaqPro, as well as engages in specialty products distribution. It also engages in the retail of animal feeds, as well as procures and sells fertilisers. Ridley Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
